definitions.explanation: Leave from work granted to a woman before and after childbirth. In Japan, legally mandated as 6 weeks before the due date and 8 weeks after birth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{産休|さんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ります→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I'll be going on maternity leave starting next month.

examples.japanese: {産休|さんきゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}した→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I just returned from maternity leave.

examples.japanese: {産休|さんきゅう}・⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More employees are taking maternity and parental leave.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of {産前産後休業|さんぜんさんごきゅうぎょう} (pre- and post-natal leave).

{産|さん} (childbirth) + {休|きゅう} (leave/rest)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{産休|さんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ - to go on maternity leave
・{産休|さんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ - to take maternity leave
・{産休|さんきゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}する→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧ - to return from maternity leave
・{産休|さんきゅう}・⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧ - maternity and parental leave (often paired)

LEGAL CONTEXT:
Under Japanese labor law, maternity leave ({産前産後休業|さんぜんさんごきゅうぎょう}) consists of:
・{産前|さんぜん}⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧: 6 weeks before due date (8 weeks for multiple births)
・⟦{産後|さんご}→産後：29056_sango⟧⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧: 8 weeks after birth (mandatory)

This is distinct from ⟦{育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう}→育児休業：25440_ikujikyuugyou⟧ (parental leave), which can follow maternity leave.
